rooted.description: An app whose pages in folders resolve relative URLs from the app's root.
rooted.$comment: An app whose pages in folders resolve their relative URLs from the app's root, the base every page had until each page was based at its own folder (apps.ts `asset`). Worn by the apps whose pages were written against the old base (app-grep found one, thecompanygardener's openai-math, T-124410); nothing else wears it.

publishing.description: The paths an app has published files at, so a request at one of them is answered its file before the app runs. A request at any other path goes on to the app without asking. An app that never published wears none.

paths.description: The paths, sorted, as a JSON list in one text property.

publishing.$comment: public-files.ts. The directory keeps it in the transaction that writes the files themselves (./publishing-graph.ts).

join.description: Who may join an app through its own rows, set by its space's owner. Only the kernel writes it, and a copy of an app uses only its owner's policy.

declared.description: The policy the original app's deployed manifest declares.
